join_order.notes: Resolve single target_ct_id once via scan of company_type/kind.{off,dat}; ct.id is dense (row+1).
Driver is title; for each surviving t row, range-probe mc via offsets_only index keyed by t_id (mc sorted by movie_id).
After mc semi-join, range-probe mi via offsets_only index keyed by t_id.
No filter on info_type; FK guarantees mi.info_type_id matches some it.id. Skip explicit probe; only require mi.info_type_id non-NULL (already implied by FK).

filters.predicate: note LIKE '%(theatrical)%' AND note LIKE '%(France)%' (len>=22, both memmem)
info IN (8 European country/language literals); length prefilter (max 9 bytes)

data_structures.target_ct_id: int32_t scalar (single value resolved at startup)
data_structures.mi_info_set: flat_hash_set<string_view> of 8 literals (compile-time array, linear search acceptable given n=8 — prefer small inline switch on length then memcmp)
data_structures.aggregation: per-thread local std::string current_min; final merge with lexicographic compare

parallelism.notes: Partition title row space [0, 2528312) into morsels; each thread maintains local MIN string; reduce across threads at end.

indexes.purpose: join_lookup (range probe mc rows by t.id)
join_lookup (range probe mi rows by t.id)

execution_order_per_title_row: 2. t_id = r + 1; lo=mc_off[t_id], hi=mc_off[t_id+1]; if lo==hi skip
3. for mc_r in [lo,hi): test mc_ct[mc_r]==target_ct_id; then load note via off[mc_r..mc_r+1]; length prefilter (>=22); memmem for '(theatrical)' AND '(France)'. break on first match -> mc_ok=true
6. for mi_r in [lo2,hi2): load info via off[mi_r..mi_r+1]; length prefilter (<=9); check membership in 8-literal set. break on first match -> mi_ok=true
8. load t.title via title/title.{off,dat}; update local MIN if cur_title < cur_min
